lines.text: Jane gets this text. Should she pay?
Cloud checkers read your private messages. Small models miss the hard ones.
Shortstop fields it first. When unsure, it throws to first base, secrets masked.
Harder one. Only the masked text goes to the cloud. It never sees Jane's name or account.
One letter is off. Shortstop flags it before John clicks.
Same engine, outgoing. Names and numbers stay home.
On 150 unseen messages: 98% of scams caught, 82% never left the laptop, one private value out of 348 sent.
Shortstop. Small model first. Your secrets stay home.
